authority: CEO Round 167: 'The loop is currently an autonomous orchestrator, not yet an autonomous discovery scientist. The system needs to autonomously generate the next scientific question, not merely choose from a predefined action menu. Upgrade from action-selection to hypothesis-generation.'
constitutional_basis: Article V — fail closed, but do not become a universal rejector
Article XVII — every control must have an attempted bypass
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate; optimize for truth
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion
Article XXIX — separate implementation failure from mechanism failure
Article XXXII — state strongest alternative explanation
Article XXXIV — stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck
Article XXXV — closed-loop epistemic control as the completion standard
Article XXXVI — Experiment Validity Gate (ratified Round 160)

the_five_upgrades_from_v1_to_v2.upgrade_1: FROM action-selection TO hypothesis-generation — the loop generates competing hypotheses and selects the highest-information experiment, not from a fixed menu
the_five_upgrades_from_v1_to_v2.upgrade_2: FROM single-stage novelty search TO escalated search pipeline — exact → synonym → functional-equivalent → component → combination → citation → competitor → recent → non-English → obviousness → stop-rule
the_five_upgrades_from_v1_to_v2.upgrade_3: FROM raw SNR classification TO evidence-strength hierarchy — 8 levels (0=conceptual plausibility → 7=physical validation); SNR>1 is Level 1-2 only
the_five_upgrades_from_v1_to_v2.upgrade_4: FROM conflated state TO orthogonal execution/epistemic states — EXECUTION_STATE (queued/running/completed/failed) is independent from EPISTEMIC_STATE (validated_positive/negative/invalid/blocked)
the_five_upgrades_from_v1_to_v2.upgrade_5: FROM 'no human involved' TO 'autonomous until external-world gate' — WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE state for patent attorney, physical experiment, buyer validation, clinical data, regulatory

step_1_READ_GOVERNANCE.description: Read EPISTEMIC_CONSTITUTION.md v1.6.0 + all governance JSON files. Verify hashes.

step_2_ASSESS_PORTFOLIO.description: Read current portfolio state. For each candidate: epistemic_state, execution_state, evidence_strength_level, uncertainty_ledger.

step_3_BUILD_UNCERTAINTY_MAP.description: For each candidate, identify what we currently believe, why it might be wrong, and what evidence is missing.

step_4_GENERATE_COMPETING_HYPOTHESES.description: For the candidate with highest uncertainty × highest potential value, generate 3-6 competing hypotheses that would explain the current observations differently.
step_4_GENERATE_COMPETING_HYPOTHESES.example: For C5-X-AE-V3: H1=AE predicts microfracture reliably, H2=AE detects fracture but cannot predict macroscopic failure, H3=AE is dominated by catheter/device friction, H4=AE varies more by clot phenotype than fracture state, H5=force/flow signals already contain the same information, H6=AE adds incremental info only under specific thrombectomy regimes

step_5_GENERATE_CANDIDATE_EXPERIMENTS.description: For each competing hypothesis, generate an experiment that would discriminate it from the others. Score experiments by expected information gain.

step_6_NOVELTY_ATTACK.description: For each candidate experiment, run the escalated novelty search pipeline. An experiment that is not novel cannot contribute to World-Class promotion.

step_7_SCORE_AND_SELECT_EXPERIMENT.description: Score experiments by: (novelty_confidence × expected_information_gain ÷ cost). Select the highest-scoring experiment.

step_8_VALIDITY_AUDIT.description: Check the 7 validity gate conditions for the selected experiment. If any fail, the experiment is INVALID and cannot update candidate belief.

step_9_EXECUTE_EXPERIMENT.description: Execute the selected experiment with frozen parameters.

step_10_ADVERSARIAL_SELF_ATTACK.description: Ask: 'What would make this result pass while the underlying system is wrong?' Document attacks and countermeasures.

step_11_UPDATE_UNCERTAINTY_LEDGER.description: Based on the results, update the uncertainty ledger. Which hypotheses were supported? Which were falsified? What new uncertainty was created?

step_12_COMMIT_PUSH.description: Commit all artifacts to git. Push to GitHub. Verify Article XXIII.

step_13_CHECK_TERMINATION_OR_LOOP.description: Check termination conditions. If none met, go to step 1 with updated uncertainty map.

the_uncertainty_ledger.authority: CEO Round 167: 'For every candidate maintain: hypothesis, prior, current belief, uncertainty, load-bearing assumptions, contradictions, missing evidence, best next discriminator.'

structure.load_bearing_assumptions: assumptions that, if wrong, would collapse the hypothesis
structure.contradictions: evidence that conflicts with the hypothesis
structure.missing_evidence: evidence that would resolve the uncertainty
structure.best_next_discriminator: the experiment with highest expected information gain

c5_x_ae_v3_uncertainty_ledger_example.hypothesis: Endogenous microfracture events during mechanical thrombectomy produce passive AE whose dynamics predict impending macroscopic fragmentation earlier than existing signals.
c5_x_ae_v3_uncertainty_ledger_example.uncertainty: HIGH — physics feasibility established (Level 1-2) but no prediction, classification, or incremental value demonstrated
load_bearing_assumptions: Mechanical clot fracture produces detectable AE (SUPPORTED by Round 166 physics feasibility)
AE is not dominated by device friction noise (UNTESTED)
AE contains information about fracture progression (UNTESTED)
AE provides incremental prediction beyond force/flow (UNTESTED)
Effect is robust across clot phenotypes (PARTIALLY TESTED — 5/5 detectable but signal strength varies)
Effect does not require active ultrasound (CONFIRMED by design — receive-only)
contradictions: 2023 histotripsy paper (PMC10206501) shows passive AE of clot is KNOWN (but in different context — active treatment)
Existing force/flow sensing may already capture the same information (UNTESTED but plausible)
missing_evidence: Patent attorney FTO opinion (EXTERNAL — cannot be autonomously resolved)
Signal classification: can individual fracture events be distinguished from noise? (Level 3)
Pre-fragmentation prediction: does AE lead force/flow signals? (Level 4)
Incremental predictive value: does AE add information beyond force+flow+imaging? (Level 5)
Independent reproduction via external solver (Level 6 — requires clotFoam/OpenFOAM v9)
c5_x_ae_v3_uncertainty_ledger_example.best_next_discriminator: AUTONOMOUSLY EXECUTABLE: simulate AE vs force/flow signal competition — does AE contain information NOT present in force/flow? This is Level 5 (incremental prediction) and can be done with a virtual clot model.

the_contradiction_generator.authority: CEO Round 167: 'After every valid experiment, ask: What result would make the current conclusion wrong? Then generate competing hypotheses.'

example_for_c5_x_ae_v3.current_conclusion: Mechanical clot fracture produces detectable AE across all 5 clot phenotypes (SNR > 1).
example_for_c5_x_ae_v3.strongest_way_it_could_be_wrong: The AE signal is dominated by device-catheter friction, not clot fracture. The detectability is real but the SOURCE is wrong — we're hearing the device, not the clot.
competing_hypotheses: H1: AE predicts microfracture reliably (the desired hypothesis)
H2: AE detects fracture but cannot predict macroscopic failure (detection ≠ prediction)
H3: AE is dominated by catheter/device friction (the signal is not from the clot)
H4: AE varies more by clot phenotype than fracture state (phenotype confound)
H5: Force/flow signals already contain the same information (no incremental value)
H6: AE adds incremental info only under specific thrombectomy regimes (conditional value)
example_for_c5_x_ae_v3.next_discriminating_experiment: Simulate AE generation with and without clot fracture (fracture ON vs fracture OFF). If AE disappears when fracture is disabled → H1/H2 supported. If AE persists → H3 supported (device noise). This experiment is AUTONOMOUSLY EXECUTABLE (virtual clot model).

evidence_strength_hierarchy.authority: CEO Round 167: 'SNR > 1 is nowhere close to evidence that an AE system can provide a clinically useful signal.'

levels.LEVEL_0: CONCEPTUAL_PLAUSIBILITY — the idea makes physical sense
levels.LEVEL_1: PHYSICS_FEASIBILITY — order-of-magnitude estimates show the signal is above the noise floor
levels.LEVEL_2: SIGNAL_DETECTABILITY — the signal can be detected in a realistic simulation (SNR > threshold)
levels.LEVEL_3: CLASSIFICATION — individual events can be classified (fracture vs noise, fracture type)
levels.LEVEL_4: PREDICTION — the signal predicts impending failure before it occurs
levels.LEVEL_5: INCREMENTAL_PREDICTION — the signal adds information beyond the best existing signals (force/flow/imaging)
levels.LEVEL_6: INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION — the result survives an external solver (not just our internal model)
levels.LEVEL_7: PHYSICAL_VALIDATION — the result is confirmed in a physical experiment

evidence_strength_hierarchy.current_c5_x_ae_v3_level: LEVEL_2 (signal detectability — SNR > 1 in physics model)
evidence_strength_hierarchy.level_required_for_world_class: LEVEL_6 (independent reproduction) minimum; LEVEL_7 (physical validation) for full promotion
evidence_strength_hierarchy.the_gap: C5-X-AE-V3 is at Level 2. World-Class requires Level 6-7. The gap is 4-5 levels. Each level requires a different experiment. The loop must generate and execute experiments to climb the hierarchy.

orthogonal_state_system.authority: CEO Round 167: 'Separate execution state from epistemic state. No execution status may automatically update scientific belief.'
orthogonal_state_system.the_orthogonality_rule: EXECUTION_STATE and EPISTEMIC_STATE are independent. A completed execution (EXECUTION_STATE=COMPLETED) does NOT mean the result is valid (EPISTEMIC_STATE may be EXPERIMENT_INVALID). A failed execution (EXECUTION_STATE=FAILED) does NOT mean the candidate is killed (EPISTEMIC_STATE may be INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED, not VALIDATED_NEGATIVE).
examples: EXECUTION_STATE=COMPLETED + EPISTEMIC_STATE=VALIDATED_POSITIVE → result is valid and supports the hypothesis
EXECUTION_STATE=COMPLETED + EPISTEMIC_STATE=EXPERIMENT_INVALID → result was produced but cannot update belief (validity gate failed)
EXECUTION_STATE=FAILED + EPISTEMIC_STATE=INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED → execution failed due to infrastructure, candidate unchanged
EXECUTION_STATE=QUEUED + EPISTEMIC_STATE=WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE → experiment cannot start because external evidence (patent attorney, physical) is required

the_external_evidence_boundary.authority: CEO Round 167: 'The autonomous loop must have an explicit STOP — ASK HUMAN boundary. The machine cannot autonomously produce patent attorney FTO, physical experimental evidence, human buyer willingness-to-pay, clinical evidence, or regulatory approval.'
the_external_evidence_boundary.the_boundary: The loop is AUTONOMOUS until it hits an external-world gate. At that point, the state becomes WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE.
external_gates: PATENT_ATTORNEY_FTO — requires legal expertise, cannot be resolved by code
PHYSICAL_EXPERIMENT — requires lab equipment, cannot be resolved by simulation alone
BUYER_VALIDATION — requires human negotiation, cannot be resolved by analysis alone
CLINICAL_DATA — requires clinical trial or real-world data, cannot be generated by simulation
REGULATORY_EVIDENCE — requires FDA/EMA submission, cannot be self-generated
loop_behavior_at_boundary: 1. Record exactly what evidence is missing
2. Generate everything it CAN do autonomously while waiting (e.g., deeper simulation, more novelty search, new hypotheses)
3. Revisit automatically when new evidence becomes available (e.g., when patent attorney FTO is provided as input)
4. Do NOT pretend the machine can generate external evidence
5. Do NOT block indefinitely on a single candidate — move to the next actionable candidate

the_autonomous_objective.authority: CEO Round 167: 'The machine should now run toward one of two terminal states for every candidate: WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION or KILLED_BY_EVIDENCE.'

terminal_states.WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION: All 8 gate conditions + 4 hostile questions pass. Evidence strength >= Level 6. Portfolio slot filled.
terminal_states.KILLED_BY_EVIDENCE: A valid experiment (validity gate passed) produced a VALIDATED_NEGATIVE result meeting KILL thresholds. Cemetery entry created. Cannot be resurrected without fundamentally different mechanism + new novelty search.

the_autonomous_objective.intermediate_states: EXIST ONLY TO DESCRIBE THE JOURNEY. The loop does not stop at intermediate states — it continues toward one of the two terminal states.
the_autonomous_objective.the_principle: The AI is not allowed to manufacture success by lowering standards. It must become more creative in finding better hypotheses while becoming more ruthless about proving them wrong.

the_difference_between_workflow_and_disc.authority: CEO Round 167: 'An AI workflow says: Run the next task. An AI discovery engine says: What do we currently believe? Why might that belief be wrong? What are the competing explanations? Which experiment would most efficiently distinguish them? Has the experiment itself survived an attack? What did we learn? What new invention hypotheses does that create?'
the_difference_between_workflow_and_disc.workflow: portfolio → choose action from known experiment menu → execute → repeat
the_difference_between_workflow_and_disc.discovery_engine: portfolio → uncertainty map → generate competing hypotheses → generate candidate experiments → novelty attack → score experiments → execute → validity audit → adversarial self-attack → update → generate next hypothesis → repeat
the_difference_between_workflow_and_disc.the_key_capability: The discovery engine can SURPRISE US. It can say: 'The CEO's proposed next experiment is no longer the best experiment because the evidence changed.' The CEO provides the mission (find World-Class inventions). The AI chooses the scientifically optimal route.

what_the_loop_CAN_do_autonomously: Generate competing hypotheses (H1-H6 per the contradiction generator)
Generate discriminating experiments (fracture ON vs OFF simulation)
Execute the fracture ON/OFF simulation (virtual clot model, autonomously executable)
Climb the evidence hierarchy from Level 2 toward Level 5 (incremental prediction)
If Level 5 is reached: the candidate has STRONG autonomous evidence, strengthening the case for patent attorney investment
what_the_loop_does_next_for_c5_x_ae_v3.the_next_autonomous_action: Execute the fracture ON/OFF discrimination experiment. This tests H3 (AE dominated by device friction) vs H1 (AE from clot fracture). If AE disappears when fracture is disabled, H1 is supported and H3 is falsified. This is the highest-information experiment available without external gates.
